trajectory.patch:
The Kconfig warning indicates that `STDOUT_CONSOLE` is being enabled, but its dependencies are not met for the `native_sim` target. This is because `native_sim` selects `NATIVE_LIBRARY` and defaults to using `EXTERNAL_LIBC`, which makes the dependency `!(NATIVE_LIBRARY && EXTERNAL_LIBC)` evaluate to false.

The `STDOUT_CONSOLE` option is intended to redirect standard I/O to a console driver when using Zephyr's minimal C library (`MINIMAL_LIBC`). Other C libraries like Newlib, Picolibc, or an external (host) C library have their own mechanisms for handling standard I/O.

The current dependency `!(NATIVE_LIBRARY && EXTERNAL_LIBC)` is a workaround that is not entirely correct, as it would allow `STDOUT_CONSOLE` to be enabled with Newlib or Picolibc on non-native targets, where it has no effect.

The correct fix is to make `STDOUT_CONSOLE` depend directly on `MINIMAL_LIBC`, as the feature it enables is part of the minimal C library implementation. This will resolve the warning for native builds (which use `EXTERNAL_LIBC` by default) and also make the Kconfig dependency more accurate for all other targets.

lib/libc/Kconfig
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
config STDOUT_CONSOLE
	bool "Send stdout to console"
	depends on CONSOLE_HAS_DRIVER
	depends on !(NATIVE_LIBRARY && EXTERNAL_LIBC)
	default y
	help
	  This option directs standard output (e.g. printf) to the console
	  device, rather than suppressing it entirely. See also EARLY_CONSOLE
	  option.
========
config STDOUT_CONSOLE
	bool "Send stdout to console"
	depends on CONSOLE_HAS_DRIVER
	depends on MINIMAL_LIBC
	default y
	help
	  This option directs standard output (e.g. printf) to the console
	  device, rather than suppressing it entirely. See also EARLY_CONSOLE
	  option.
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
